_doc: Word-check vetoes on the full-align statistical layer's fn channel (fullalign_build.py; eval/word_checks.py veto_checks_for). For each language, the checks whose flagged FUNCTION-word links are kept out of the fn channel (the row stays in `rows`, its profile extra carries `veto`). Decided by `word_checks --veto-ab --ot` against the language's gold: statistical union spanext+eflomal+gloss+gapfill (first wins), with vs without the flagged links, word grain decides (F1 up AND exact spans up). Deterministic (same alignment files), no replicates needed. A language without an entry gets no veto. Measured 2026-10-09, whole OT; numbers = word-grain delta F1 / delta exact spans.
